summary:
Attempt 2 discharges O-001 and O-002 and changes nothing else. The four fixes from attempt 1 stand as committed.
- **O-001 (R2-m2):** New-CaseFolder and TempTree.CreateRoot still refuse and remove the compressed leaf. Their messages now name the parent folder that carries the attribute (fsa-window-cases or fsa-tests), not "%TEMP% or a folder above it". They give the remedy `compact /u /s:"<that folder>"`. I checked that remedy in a scratch folder: it clears the folder, its subfolders and its files, and the next leaf comes out plain while %TEMP% above stays compressed. The reviewer's form, `compact /u /s "<folder>"`, clears only the folder's own attribute, the same as plain `compact /u`.
- **O-002 (R2-m3):** SmbLibraryPinTests now also asserts that no csproj under tests defines FsaSmbLibraryVersion or FsaSmbLibraryWin32Version.

Each test was seen failing first, then passing. After the fixes, the full suite passed 400/400 and the bug catalog 10/10.

files.why: O-001: New-CaseFolder's refusal names the parent folder that carries the attribute and gives `compact /u /s:"<parent>"`. The comment records why that form and not `/u` or `/u /s "folder"`.
O-001: CreateRoot's refusal names the parent folder (fsa-tests) and gives `compact /u /s:"<parent>"`, the same as New-CaseFolder.

O-001 test, the reviewer's scenario. With a compressed temp, CreateRoot(temp\fsa-tests\root) is refused, and the message must name temp\fsa-tests. The test then runs the message's own `compact /u /s:"..."` through cmd.exe as written; the next CreateRoot must make a root that is not compressed.

O-001 test for New-CaseFolder, all in one pwsh session: refused, the message names temp\fsa-window-cases, the refused leaf is gone, the message's remedy runs through cmd.exe with exit 0, and the next New-CaseFolder makes a plain Directory.
O-002: inside the csproj loop, assert that no project defines either pin property: "{relative} redefines {property}; it is pinned once in Directory.Build.props".

obligations.how: Both refusals now name the folder the removed leaf was made in, which carries the attribute: %TEMP%\fsa-window-cases for New-CaseFolder and %TEMP%\fsa-tests for TempTree.CreateRoot. Both give `compact /u /s:"<that folder>"` instead of 'Uncompress %TEMP% (compact /u)'. I measured before choosing it. In a scratch folder under a compressed temp, `compact /u /s:"parent"` cleared the parent, its old subfolder and that subfolder's file, and a new leaf came out plain; it works through cmd with a space in the path. The reviewer's suggested `compact /u /s "parent"`, and plain `compact /u`, cleared only the parent's own attribute. I also left the parent in place rather than deleting it when empty, because the parent is exactly what the remedy has to name. The tests replay the reviewer's repro: refused, then the message's own remedy run through cmd.exe, then made uncompressed. Both failed on the old message and pass now.

The csproj loop in SmbLibraryPinTests now asserts that XDocument.Load(project).Descendants(property) is empty for both FsaSmbLibraryVersion and FsaSmbLibraryWin32Version. To check it, I temporarily added <FsaSmbLibraryVersion>1.6.0</FsaSmbLibraryVersion> to StallRig.csproj. The old test passed with it, which is the gap; the new test failed with 'tests/window/StallRig/StallRig.csproj redefines FsaSmbLibraryVersion; it is pinned once in Directory.Build.props.' I then removed the line; git diff HEAD shows StallRig.csproj unchanged, and the test passes.

tests.command: compact.exe /U /S:<parent> vs compact.exe /U /S <parent> vs compact.exe /U <parent> (scratch folder under %TEMP%, deleted afterwards)
tests.note: Measurement for O-001, on a scratch temp set with compact /C, a fsa-window-cases parent, and an old subfolder holding a 64 KiB file. Only /U /S:<parent> cleared the parent, the old subfolder and its file. /U /S <parent> and /U <parent> cleared only the parent's own attribute; the old subfolder and file stayed Compressed. In all three, temp stayed Compressed and a new leaf came out plain. A second run through cmd.exe with the exact printed text `compact /u /s:"...\te mp\fsa-tests"` (spaces in the path) exited 0 and cleared the same.

RED, with the new tests on the old code and a temporary 1.6.0 redefinition in StallRig.csproj: 2 failed, 2 passed. The TempTree refusal failed because the message does not name fsa-tests. New-CaseFolder failed because it gave no compact /u /s: remedy, and its second call was 'refused again' with the same '%TEMP% or a folder above it' text, which reproduces R2-m2. SmbLibraryPinTests passed despite the redefinition, which is the R2-m3 gap.

RED for the guard, with the new assertion in place and StallRig still redefining the pin: failed with 'tests/window/StallRig/StallRig.csproj redefines FsaSmbLibraryVersion; it is pinned once in Directory.Build.props.' I removed the redefinition straight after; git diff HEAD on StallRig.csproj is empty.
GREEN after the fixes: 9 of 9 passed. This includes WindowCasesIsAscii and the 5.1 and 7 parses of the edited WindowCases.ps1.
Full suite: 400 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 26 s.

The real entry point, on New-CaseFolder's unchanged success path, against the published app. OutcomeDetail lines 1 and 2 matched the tree, including 'taking X on disk'. PASSED: C-001, exit 0. I did not rerun -Case All: the only line changed in the window script is the refusal branch, which never runs on this machine's plain %TEMP%. Attempt 1's -Case All result (everything passes except the display-bound T-003, which fails the same way at HEAD) still stands.

deviations: O-001's recorded fix proposes the remedy `compact /u /s "<folder>"`. I measured it in a scratch folder: it clears only that folder's own attribute, the same as plain `compact /u`, and leaves the folders and files inside it compressed. The refusals therefore print `compact /u /s:"<folder>"` (the colon form), which the same measurement showed clearing the folder and everything in it, through cmd and with spaces in the path. The folder named is the one the reviewer asked for, the new folder's parent. I did not also delete the parent when it is left empty, because the message names the parent for the remedy to act on.
follow_ups: The review's m1 (deferred): WindowCasesHelperTests.Pwsh and TempTreeTests.Cmd are two more copies of the ProcessStartInfo harness, and FindRepo is still copied per class. They belong in the Core.Tests tidy slice m1 was deferred to.
